stripeSellerPayout.primaryQuote: To list a skill for sale, you must create an account and set up a payout method. You may either connect a Stripe account via Stripe Connect, or onboard with Zoneless, our stablecoin payout partner, to receive payouts in USDC on Solana. ... You may not publish a paid skill until one of these payout methods is set up and enabled.

supportingQuotes.text: Payouts are processed via Stripe Connect. Direct purchase payouts are processed according to Stripe's standard payout schedule. Credit install earnings are aggregated monthly and transferred to your Stripe Connect account.

To sell skills on Agensi, you must connect a Stripe account via Stripe Connect. ... 70% is paid to the creator's connected Stripe account. 30% is retained by Agensi as a platform fee (all-inclusive, covers payment processing). ... For a $5.00 skill purchase (minimum price).

Agensi uses Stripe Connect for all creator payouts. You keep 70% of every skill sale. Payouts go directly to your bank account through Stripe's standard payout schedule (typically 2-7 business days depending on your country).

stripeSellerPayout.staleness: stripe-terms and the payouts learn article still describe Stripe as the only rail. ToS §6.1 (2026-09-02) adds Zoneless USDC as an alternative and says Stripe Connect takes precedence if both are active. Hub blurb still advertises 80/20; article body and ToS are 70/30.

solanaUsdcSellerPayout.primaryQuote: Creators who select USDC (Solana) payouts are paid through Zoneless rather than through Stripe. Earnings accrue as a pending balance in your Creator dashboard as sales settle. Each amount becomes payable 72 hours after the underlying transaction settles, and Agensi releases it to your Zoneless account and on to your payout wallet automatically at the next payout run after that 72-hour period. Payout runs happen multiple times per day.

supportingQuotes.text: USDC payouts are sent as USDC on the Solana network, via Zoneless, to the payout wallet on file with your Zoneless account. ... Payout amounts are denominated in US dollars and sent 1:1 in USDC.
Payouts reach you through Stripe or as USDC on Solana through Zoneless.
Payouts via Stripe, or USDC on Solana through Zoneless. No hidden fees.
